set.body: Implement transactional scoped events and keyed-source committed change events, debounce with monotonic/manual clocks, a fair bounded unified owner driver and bounded numeric cause/settle diagnostics. Add independent event/deadline model, JVM/Native edge and workbench rapid-typing/disposal controls, review and durable receipts. Preserve concurrent graphics/text/Unicode work; no renderer, animation or GC soak qualification.
set.title: C1.3/C1.8/C1.9 events, deadlines and bounded driver
